decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the rear first floor rear elevation shall be obscured glazed and shall be hinged at the right hand side and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that the application for the erection of a first floor and roof extension and demolition of existing single storey rear extension and erection of a new single storey rear extension would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing dwelling or the character of the street scene and surrounding area. The proposal is generally consistent with the Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (2002). Where the proposal is not compliant, it is considered that there will be no undue adverse affects resulting from this.
description: Erection of first and roof extension and demolition of existing single storey rear extension and erection of new single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
